entries.reason: ETXTBSY ("Text file busy") is a Linux refusal to exec a file that any process holds open for writing; Windows has no such refusal and its fixture script is read by Git's shell, never executed, so the warm-up that waits it out does not exist there
entries.approved_platform: operator, 2026-10-11 (the Linux-only ETXTBSY warm-up test in helper_script.rs may be a platform row); recorded in the Windows parity lanes A-D brief of 2026-10-12, not yet in the plan
